bio: Serving flavoursome dishes made from fresh, high-quality ingredients in a pleasant contemporary atmosphere, this restaurant on the corner is a real gem. Its short menu draws on both Mediterranean and classical influences. This place also doubles as a wine bar, so you can look forward to a well-curated wine list. Experienced and charming waitstaff provide great service with a personal touch. In summer, the tables out front, facing the street, are in high demand....
